title: Programmatic Is Coming To Local Linear TV - TV News Check

facts.fact: Panelists at a TVNewsCheck webinar agreed that local linear television advertising will be bought and sold on programmatic platforms within the next two to three years.
facts.quote: Local linear television advertising will be bought and sold on programmatic platforms within the next two to three years, agreed panelists

facts.fact: The article states that local linear television has been losing ground to digital competitors for at least the last decade.
facts.quote: It’s well known that local linear television has been losing ground to digital competitors for at least the last decade.

facts.fact: The article is dated June 9, 2025, and was written by Paige Albiniak.
